items.title: Mike De Lay Interview, 1970-11-14
items.q: His name is Ernie, Ernest Mc Lane.

ctx.x: I couldn't, I couldn't think that myself. I know, a lot, a lot of, uh... Do you think he was fairly taken? Huh? Do you think he was fairly taken about it?

Well, I don't really know. Because I never heard him. I started, uh... I don't know about his technique or on. I couldn't say anything about that. He had to play one number in my life, just a lot of that. I never heard. Do you have any records on? Oh, yeah. No. Uh, I know about Cornell and them working with him, and I heard about that. But I mean, uh, you see, that's before I even flew around with Dixonan. I didn't start flew around with Dixonan until up here. That was through, that was through, mostly through,…
